description: The agent must execute a three-step workflow: STEP 1 — Use `extract_format.py` on `templates/approved/official_template.docx` to produce `template_format.json`, which captures the proprietary page margins (3.7cm/3.5cm/2.8cm/2.6cm) and paragraph styles (heading1=黑体, body=仿宋_GB2312 with 2-char first-line indent, etc.). STEP 2 — Use `apply_multi_format.py drafts/internal/digital_transform_report.md --format-json template_format.json --output digital_transform_report_formatted.docx` to convert the Markdown report to a properly-formatted Word file applying all extracted styles including character-based first-line indents (firstLineChars XML attribute), east-Asian font settings, and exact page margins. STEP 3 — Use `apply_multi_format.py reports/annual/safety_check_briefing.txt --official --output safety_check_briefing_official.md` to convert the text briefing to Markdown using the built-in GB/T 9704-2012 rules, where 一、二、 headings become ## and （一）（二） headings become ### per the Markdown recognition matrix.
